Date Picker

The Date Picker renders a calendar popup from a single text input. Add data-zak-datepicker and the popup appears on focus; pick a day and the value is written back to the input.

Basic Date Picker

Click or focus the input to open the calendar. Selecting a day fills the field with an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

HTML
<input type="text" class="zak-input" data-zak-datepicker>

Custom Format

Change the output format with data-zak-datepicker-format. Supported tokens: YYYY, MM, DD.

HTML
<input type="text" class="zak-input"
       data-zak-datepicker
       data-zak-datepicker-format="MM/DD/YYYY">

Min & Max Dates

Constrain the selectable range with data-zak-datepicker-min and data-zak-datepicker-max. Out-of-range days are disabled.

HTML
<input type="text" class="zak-input"
       data-zak-datepicker
       data-zak-datepicker-min="2026-09-01"
       data-zak-datepicker-max="2026-09-30">

Pre-selected Date

Place a valid date in value to preselect it and mark it in the calendar. The today day is tinted with the primary color.

HTML
<input type="text" class="zak-input"
       data-zak-datepicker value="2026-09-08">

Change Event

The input fires zak:change when a day is picked; event.detail carries date and value.

No selection yet.

HTML
<input type="text" class="zak-input" id="shipDate" data-zak-datepicker>

<script>
    document.getElementById('shipDate').addEventListener('zak:change', function (e) {
        console.log(e.detail.date, e.detail.value);
    });
</script>

CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-datepicker                /* Wrapper injected around the input */
.zak-datepicker-popup          /* Calendar popup (hidden until active) */
.zak-datepicker-header         /* Month nav row */
.zak-datepicker-month          /* Month + year label */
.zak-datepicker-prev / .next   /* Month navigation buttons */
.zak-datepicker-weekdays       /* Su..Sa header row */
.zak-datepicker-days           /* Day grid */
.zak-datepicker-day            /* Clickable day cell */
.zak-datepicker-day.empty      /* Spacer cells */
.zak-datepicker-day.disabled   /* Out-of-range days */
.zak-datepicker-day.today      /* Current day */
.zak-datepicker-day.selected   /* Chosen day */

/* Toggle class */
.zak-datepicker-popup-active   /* Shows the popup */

JavaScript API

HTML
zak.datePicker.init()      // Bind all [data-zak-datepicker] inputs
zak.datePicker.open(input) // Open a specific picker
zak.datePicker.close(input)// Close a specific picker

// Data attributes:
data-zak-datepicker            // Enables the picker on an input
data-zak-datepicker-format     // 'YYYY-MM-DD' (default) | 'MM/DD/YYYY' etc.
data-zak-datepicker-min        // Earliest selectable date
data-zak-datepicker-max        // Latest selectable date

// Event on the input:
zak:change  // { date: Date, value: "YYYY-MM-DD" }

Accessibility

  • Days are real <button> elements, so they are focusable and operable by keyboard.
  • Focusing the input opens the popup; pressing Esc or clicking outside closes it.
  • Keep the input label associated with <label> or aria-label — the popup alone does not name the field.
  • Prefer the min/max attributes over hand-editing values so validation lives in one place.
